from pathlib import Path
import struct, json
P=Path('/tmp/fmd-fable-rereview-logfile')
PAGE=4096
FTOLD=0x01DD42A5A32A12F8
FTNEW=0x01CA8B1CFFC62000

def protect(b, usa=40):
    struct.pack_into('<HH',b,4,usa,9)
    b[usa:usa+2]=b'\x77\x00'
    for i in range(8):
        tail=(i+1)*512-2
        b[usa+2+i*2:usa+4+i*2]=b[tail:tail+2]
        b[tail:tail+2]=b'\x77\x00'
    return bytes(b)

def client(op, undoop=None, redo=b'', undo=b'', entry=10, offset=80):
    b=bytearray(40)
    if undoop is None: undoop=op
    struct.pack_into('<HHHHHHHHHHHHq',b,0,op,undoop,40 if redo else 0,len(redo),40+len(redo) if undo else 0,len(undo),0,1,56,offset-56 if offset else 0,(entry%4)*2,2,entry//4)
    struct.pack_into('<q',b,32,50)
    return bytes(b)+redo+undo

def lsn(page): return (1<<44)+((page*PAGE+64)//8)

def build(name, rows, corrupt_page=None):
    rows=[(None, rows[0][1], 0, b'', b'', None), *rows]
    last_by_client={}; pages=[]; inventory=[]
    for i,(op,clientid,txid,redo,undo,undoop) in enumerate(rows,4):
        if op is None:
            data=bytearray(112);struct.pack_into('<II',data,0,2,0);struct.pack_into('<I',data,80,4096)
        else:
            if op == 2:
                redo=(P/'current-record.bin').read_bytes()
            data=client(op,undoop,redo,undo,offset=80 if op==7 else 0)
        b=bytearray(PAGE); b[:4]=b'RCRD'
        current=lsn(i)
        struct.pack_into('<Q',b,8,current)
        struct.pack_into('<IHHH',b,16,1,1,1,64+48+len(data))
        struct.pack_into('<Q',b,32,current)
        struct.pack_into('<QQQLLLLH',b,64,current,last_by_client.get(clientid,0),0,len(data),clientid,2 if op is None else 1,txid,0)
        b[112:112+len(data)]=data
        protected=bytearray(protect(b))
        if i==corrupt_page: protected[510]^=1
        pages.append(bytes(protected)); last_by_client[clientid]=current
        inventory.append({'page':i,'lsn':current,'operation':op,'client_id':clientid,'txid':txid})
    total=(4+len(rows))*PAGE
    restart=bytearray(PAGE);restart[:4]=b'RSTR'
    struct.pack_into('<QIIHHH',restart,8,0,PAGE,PAGE,80,1,1)
    struct.pack_into('<QHHHHIHHqIHHI',restart,80,lsn(3+len(rows)),1,65535,0,0,20,224,64,total,40,48,64,1)
    struct.pack_into('<QQHHH',restart,144,lsn(4),0,65535,65535,rows[-1][1]&65535)
    struct.pack_into('<I',restart,172,8);restart[176:184]='NTFS'.encode('utf-16le')
    first=protect(restart)
    target=P/(name+'.$LogFile');target.write_bytes(first+first+bytes(PAGE*2)+b''.join(pages))
    (P/(name+'-inventory.json')).write_text(json.dumps(inventory,indent=2)+'\n')

redo=struct.pack('<QQQQ',FTNEW,FTNEW,FTOLD,FTNEW)
undo=struct.pack('<QQQQ',FTOLD,FTOLD,FTOLD,FTOLD)
build('lifecycle',[(7,1,24,redo,undo,None),(2,1,28,b'',b'',None),(27,1,24,b'',b'',0)])
build('corrupt-lifecycle',[(7,1,24,redo,undo,None),(2,1,28,b'',b'',None),(27,1,24,b'',b'',0)],corrupt_page=6)
build('client-collision',[(7,1,24,redo,undo,None),(27,2,24,b'',b'',0)])
